    Frequently Asked Questions about Greater Boston Events

    Where can I find live music and theater in Boston and Cambridge tonight?

    Wicked Boston Events tracks over 100+ local stages and theater spaces every 30 minutes, including Symphony Hall, The Sinclair, Middle East, Central Square Theater, Calderwood Pavilion (BCA), Cantab Lounge, Paradise Rock Club, Midway Cafe, Club Passim, and O'Brien's Pub.

    Are there stand-up comedy shows, plays, and free events in Boston this week?

    Yes! Check our Comedy Guide for shows at Laugh Boston, The Comedy Studio, and Improv Asylum; browse Stage & Theater for Calderwood Pavilion, Central Square Theater, and Huntington Theatre productions; or explore our Free Events Guide for museum days, Eventbrite community gatherings, open mics, and markets.

    How does Boston Events differ from commercial ticketing sites?

    Wicked Boston Events is an independent community project. It does not sell tickets, charge fees, or take broker markups. Every listing links directly to the venue's own official box office or community organizer.
